about.title: About Me
about.paragraph1: I'm a Junior Full Stack Developer focused on .NET and C# on the back-end, and AngularJS and ReactJS on the front-end. I have experience with SQL Server, MySQL, and Oracle, building complete, integrated applications with an emphasis on clean code, best practices, and responsiveness.
about.paragraph2: I work on projects involving ASP.NET Core, REST APIs, relational databases, and modern front-end technologies, always looking to learn new tools and agile methodologies to deliver quality solutions. My goal is to contribute to challenging projects as a Full Stack Developer, applying my knowledge while growing alongside my team and company.
